name: gui_rt_procedural_callable
description: RTL-2s b: a procedural sphere and a callable, from the Graph's ray tracing fields. The fixture (test/fixtures/studio_gui_rt_procedural_callable) has a cube and a procedural ball (asset `ball`) in a layout of the triangles group mesh and the procedural group ball; its task `trace` names an intersection that reports nothing for ball, so only the cube is drawn. In the grid's primary x ball cell, New... beside the closest hit writes one of the layout's form (a procedural hit's normal from the sphere) and New... beside the intersection writes a sphere: the ball is drawn. Callable shaders' New... writes a callable (a warm tint) and makes it callable 0; New... on raygen writes a raygen, and the section's Call callable 0 (RTL-2s-c) sets its CALL_CALLABLE_0 to 1, which passes the colour through it: the cube turns warm. Typed: nothing in Studio.
